headline: Last session: Sensex soared nearly 700 points as Nifty crossed 25,700 while markets held a positive undertone.

marketStatus.message: Market is closed today because it is a weekend. It will reopen on Monday, 23 November.

why: Sensex surged close to 700 points as Nifty surpassed the 25,700 mark during the last trading session.
Market experts noted a positive undertone keeping the markets buoyant despite range-bound movement.
Automakers are revising vehicle prices upwards to counter ongoing input cost pressures.
Expectations of capital raising activity via InvITs and corporate IPOs buoyed broader investor sentiment.
whatHappening: Maruti Suzuki announced a price hike on select car models to offset cost pressures.
Mahindra Last Mile Mobility revealed plans to expand into new products and target an IPO in 18 months.
The government tightened contract extension terms for seven pre-NELP oil and gas blocks.
Four to five Infrastructure Investment Trusts (InvITs) are expected to launch public issues by March 2027.
summary: In the last trading session, Indian equity markets saw strong upward momentum with Sensex rallying nearly 700 points. Key corporate news included Maruti Suzuki hiking prices to combat cost pressures and Mahindra Last Mile Mobility planning an IPO. The stock market is closed today for the weekend and will reopen on Monday, 23 November.
